<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
before = current_frame.ascii
res = action(['LEFT','LEFT','UP','UP','UP'])
after = current_frame.ascii
bl = before.split('\n'); al = after.split('\n')
chg = [(r,c,bl[r][c],al[r][c]) for r in range(len(bl)) for c in range(len(bl[r])) if bl[r][c]!=al[r][c]]
# summarize changed regions compactly
rows = sorted(set(x[0] for x in chg)); cols = sorted(set(x[1] for x in chg))
print('changed', len(chg), 'rows', rows[:8], '...', rows[-4:] if len(rows)>8 else '', 'cols', cols[:8], '...', cols[-4:] if len(cols)>8 else '')
seg = current_frame.segmentation
def bbox(n):
    bs=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in bs]; cs=[p[1] for p in bs]
    return (min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('O','b','W','w') and n['pixels']<=20:
        print(n['id'], n['color'], n['pixels'], bbox(n))
print('result', {k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
before = current_frame.ascii
res = action(['LEFT','LEFT','UP','UP','UP'])
after = current_frame.ascii
bl = before.split('\n'); al = after.split('\n')
chg = [(r,c,bl[r][c],al[r][c]) for r in range(len(bl)) for c in range(len(bl[r])) if bl[r][c]!=al[r][c]]
# summarize changed regions compactly
rows = sorted(set(x[0] for x in chg)); cols = sorted(set(x[1] for x in chg))
print('changed', len(chg), 'rows', rows[:8], '...', rows[-4:] if len(rows)>8 else '', 'cols', cols[:8], '...', cols[-4:] if len(cols)>8 else '')
seg = current_frame.segmentation
def bbox(n):
    bs=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in bs]; cs=[p[1] for p in bs]
    return (min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('O','b','W','w') and n['pixels']<=20:
        print(n['id'], n['color'], n['pixels'], bbox(n))
print('result', {k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward')})
</parameter>
</function>
